title: Flaky budgeted-prewarm test (test_budgeted_prewarm_equals_batch[1e-05])

agent_runs.label: M4-11 flaky prewarm test + P12-06 dataset survey + diagram 15 check

notes: Root cause: the test, not the decoder. The failing assert was `assert seen` (on_prewarm steps ran). With a 1e-5 s budget measured from the start of push_frames, beam.push alone usually uses the budget, so on_prewarm steps run only in rare pushes under 10 us (no load: 2 of ~130 prewarms per stream finished, seen = 10; under load seen = 0 in 1 of 3 runs). Decisions never depend on timing: the budget only decides how much of a pure memo (alignment pairs, LM rows, word caches) is filled; finalize recomputes any missing entry with the same function. Checked with an adversarial fake clock: 30 random schedules x 4 streams equal batch. Fix: injectable `CTCBeamSpec.clock` (default time.perf_counter) and `IncrementalPrefixBeam.prewarm(clock=...)`; the real-clock test now asserts results only; new deterministic tests test_budgeted_prewarm_fake_clock (schedules random / bursty / expired / frozen x 4 seeds; equality + coverage asserts) and test_beam_prewarm_fake_clock_cuts_mid_loop (deadline cut after 0..11 alignments). 50/50 runs of the budget tests under 8 busy loops (background class); full suite 650 passed / 9 skipped.
